verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills/plugin framework layered on top of existing coding agents (Claude Code, Devin, Codex, etc.), not itself an agent host that consumes external MCP servers as its own tool-use mechanism. The evidence describes it porting 'skills' to different agent harnesses, not plugging MCP servers into Superpowers itself, so this axis is a category mismatch for the product's role.
